content:
Sara (prod): getting alerts: spike in client-side 429s for hosted text-gen and subsequent customer complaints around 10:07 UTC. Seeing cascading retries and model fallback loops.
Tom (runtime): digging in. metrics show repeated fallback from primary gpt-x-large -> gpt-x-small for ~18k requests in 10m window, triggering service-level rate limits.
Infra-bot: autoscaler activity: burst scale-up to handle retries started 10:03 UTC then throttled due to overall rate-limit guardrails.
Sara (prod): which change could have triggered more fallbacks?
Tom (runtime): earlier this morning we flipped a config that lowers failure backoff to improve latency (flip by tom-runtime 08:15). That made clients retry faster on transient errors and fed into fallback policy.
Jess (cs): customers report incomplete responses and elevated latency. Sending an interim notification and advising clients to back off.
Tom (runtime): mitigation plan: 1) re-enable conservative backoff config (rollback), 2) temporarily raise per-tenant rate limits for affected keys to allow warm-up, 3) throttle automated retries at the gateway.
Infra-bot: rollback initiated for runtime backoff flag -> complete 10:18 UTC.
Rate-limit-bot: elevated rate-limits for tenants: tenant-43, tenant-87, tenant-122 applied 10:21 UTC (30m window).
Tom (runtime): applying gateway retry throttle rule now (reduce retry count from 5->2).
Sara (prod): early impact metrics: 429s down from 14% -> 3.4% over last 12 minutes, fallback rate back to normal. p95 latency improved from 1.6s -> 420ms.
Jess (cs): posted status update to affected customers and internal #customer-updates with status link.
Status-bot: incident page created: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1780701234.
Tom (runtime): follow-ups: add canary for retry/backoff config, instrument fallback loop detection alert, and add automated guard that prevents unlimited quick retries. Opening tickets and assigning to runtime infra.
Sara (prod): setting incident state to mitigated, schedule postmortem tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Add logs and timeline to incident doc. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
